import ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorGeneralDRowAdapter
import ImbalancedChen.Part3SharedFirstFactorSupportedCoreCauchy

/-!
# Actual cleaned supported-carrier consumer of the general-D row adapter

Original admissibility and literal outer-carrier membership supply every
positivity premise of the finite block adapter. The atom is the actual
cleaned original atom, and both outer cutoffs are the original scale^(sigma/4).
The inner carrier, signed resonance mask, guarded rows and complete four-branch
packets are unchanged. This is an exact finite identity, with no spectral
bound or positivity assertion for the complementary block.

The imported row adapter and its paired Fourier identity are source candidates
pending separate kernel acceptance. This consumer is likewise source-only.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen.Part3

noncomputable section

open Classical Finset
open scoped BigOperators

namespace SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer

private theorem factor_pos {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ∈ factorCarrier Q) : 0 < n := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, _⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
  have hc : 1 ≤ Nat.ceil Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ.trans (Nat.le_ceil Q)
  omega

end SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer

/-- On the actual nonzero coefficient support, original admissibility
automatically discharges every positivity premise of the packet adapter. -/
theorem MediumAtom.cleaned_smallCoreSquaredSupportedBlock_eq_pairedPacket
    (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom)
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (Z : ℝ) (resonant : Bool)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ))
    (ho : o ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.smallCoreSquaredSupportedOuterCarrier
      (d.scale ^ (sigma / 4)) (d.scale ^ (sigma / 4))) :
    d.cleanedAlphaAtom.smallCoreSquaredBlock Z resonant o =
      ∑ u ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
        ∑ v ∈ d.cleanedAlphaAtom.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
          if decide (u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ) ∨
              u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = -(v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ))) = resonant then
            d.cleanedAlphaAtom.smallCoreSquaredPairedPacketTerm Z o u v
          else 0 := by
  let e := d.cleanedAlphaAtom
  have he : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 e :=
    mediumAdmissible_cleanedAlphaAtom hd
  have hoOuter : o ∈ e.smallCoreSquaredOuterCarrier :=
    ((e.mem_smallCoreSquaredSupportedOuterCarrier
      (d.scale ^ (sigma / 4)) (d.scale ^ (sigma / 4)) o).mp ho).1
  change o ∈ ((e.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
    (e.transposedAtom.betaCarrier ×ˢ e.transposedAtom.betaCarrier)).filter
      (fun t => t.2.1 ≠ t.2.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)) ×ˢ
    ((factorCarrier e.Q3) ×ˢ ((factorCarrier e.Q3) ×ˢ factorCarrier e.Q2)).biUnion
      (fun t => (t.2.1 * t.2.2).divisors.image (fun D => (t, D))) at hoOuter
  have hPairs := (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hoOuter).1).1
  have hpCarrier : o.1.1 ∈ factorCarrier e.Q1 :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hPairs).1).1
  have hN1Carrier : o.1.2.1 ∈ factorCarrier e.U :=
    (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hPairs).2).1
  have hN2Carrier : o.1.2.2 ∈ factorCarrier e.U :=
    (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hPairs).2).2
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hImage⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hoOuter).2
  obtain ⟨D, _hD, hImageEq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hImage
  have htEq : t = o.2.1 := congrArg Prod.fst hImageEq
  rw [htEq] at ht
  have hrCarrier : o.2.1.1 ∈ factorCarrier e.Q3 := (Finset.mem_product.mp ht).1
  have hr'Carrier : o.2.1.2.1 ∈ factorCarrier e.Q3 :=
    (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp ht).2).1
  have hs'Carrier : o.2.1.2.2 ∈ factorCarrier e.Q2 :=
    (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp ht).2).2
  have hp : 0 < o.1.1 :=
    SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer.factor_pos he.2.2.1 hpCarrier
  have hr : 0 < o.2.1.1 :=
    SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer.factor_pos he.2.2.2.2.1 hrCarrier
  have hr' : 0 < o.2.1.2.1 :=
    SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer.factor_pos he.2.2.2.2.1 hr'Carrier
  have hs' : 0 < o.2.1.2.2 :=
    SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer.factor_pos he.2.2.2.1 hs'Carrier
  have hw : 0 < o.2.1.2.1 * o.2.1.2.2 := Nat.mul_pos hr' hs'
  have hN1 : 0 < o.1.2.1 :=
    SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer.factor_pos he.1 hN1Carrier
  have hN2 : 0 < o.1.2.2 :=
    SharedGeneralDSupportedRowConsumer.factor_pos he.1 hN2Carrier
  exact e.smallCoreSquaredBlock_eq_pairedPacket Z resonant o he.2.2.2.1
    hp hr hw hN1 hN2

end

end ImbalancedChen.Part3

def packet (p r s s' w N1 N2 : ℕ) (a h h' : ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let D := (r * s).gcd w
  let d := r.gcd D
  let q := D / d
  let r0 := r / d
  let t := s / q
  let t' := s' / q
  let g := N1.gcd N2
  let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
  let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
  let n2 := N2 / g
  let A := g * d1
  let w0 := w / D
  let b := A * n2 * r0
  let c := n1 * w0
  let zeta := c * p * D * r0
  let K := (p * D) * r0 * w0
  let f : ℤ := ((d1 : ℤ) * n1 - n2) / (p * D : ℕ)
  let k : ℤ := h * (t' : ℤ) - h' * (t : ℤ)
  let z := t * t'
  fourier 1
      (((-(a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (zeta * z) A : ℝ) / A) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle) *
    fourier 1 ((((a : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) /
      ((N1 : ℝ) * K * z)) : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) *
    fourier 1
      ((((a : ℝ) * (f : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) *
        (CanonicalReciprocalPhase.wPhaseInverse (b * z) c : ℝ) / c) : ℝ) :
          UnitAddCircle)

private theorem factor_pos {Q : ℝ} (hQ : 1 ≤ Q) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n ∈ factorCarrier Q) : 0 < n := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, _⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hn
  have hc : 1 ≤ Nat.ceil Q := by exact_mod_cast hQ.trans (Nat.le_ceil Q)
  omega

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredPairedPacketTerm (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) (u v : ℕ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let p := o.1.1
  let N1 := o.1.2.1
  let N2 := o.1.2.2
  let r := o.2.1.1
  let w := o.2.1.2.1 * o.2.1.2.2
  let D := o.2.2
  let alpha := SharedGeneralDRowAdapter.amplitude d Z p r u.1 w u.2
  let beta := SharedGeneralDRowAdapter.amplitude d Z p r v.1 w v.2
  if ((r * u.1).gcd w = D ∧ ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * u.1)) (p * w) N1 N2) ∧
      ((r * v.1).gcd w = D ∧ ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * v.1)) (p * w) N1 N2) then
    (d.gamma2 u.1 * star (d.gamma2 v.1)) / 4 *
      (alpha * star beta *
          SharedGeneralDRowAdapter.packet p r u.1 v.1 w N1 N2 d.residue u.2 v.2 +
        alpha * beta *
          SharedGeneralDRowAdapter.packet p r u.1 v.1 w N1 N2 d.residue u.2 (-v.2) +
        star alpha * star beta *
          SharedGeneralDRowAdapter.packet p r u.1 v.1 w N1 N2 d.residue (-u.2) v.2 +
        star alpha * beta *
          SharedGeneralDRowAdapter.packet p r u.1 v.1 w N1 N2 d.residue (-u.2) (-v.2))
  else 0

theorem MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm_pair_packet
    (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) (u v : ℕ × ℤ)
    (hp : 0 < o.1.1) (hr : 0 < o.2.1.1)
    (hs : 0 < u.1) (hs' : 0 < v.1)
    (hw : 0 < o.2.1.2.1 * o.2.1.2.2)
    (hN1 : 0 < o.1.2.1) (hN2 : 0 < o.1.2.2) :
    d.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm Z o u * star (d.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm Z o v) =
      d.smallCoreSquaredPairedPacketTerm Z o u v := by

theorem MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredBlock_eq_pairedPacket
    (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ) (resonant : Bool)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ))
    (hQ2 : 1 ≤ d.Q2) (hp : 0 < o.1.1) (hr : 0 < o.2.1.1)
    (hw : 0 < o.2.1.2.1 * o.2.1.2.2)
    (hN1 : 0 < o.1.2.1) (hN2 : 0 < o.1.2.2) :
    d.smallCoreSquaredBlock Z resonant o =
      ∑ u ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
        ∑ v ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
          if decide (u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ) ∨
              u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = -(v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ))) = resonant then
            d.smallCoreSquaredPairedPacketTerm Z o u v
          else 0 := by

theorem sharedGeneralD_paired_fourier
    {p r s s' w N1 N2 : ℕ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hr : 0 < r) (hs : 0 < s) (hs' : 0 < s') (hw : 0 < w)
    (hN1 : 0 < N1) (hN2 : 0 < N2)
    (hc : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s)) (p * w) N1 N2)
    (hc' : ComplexCRT.Compatible (p * (r * s')) (p * w) N1 N2)
    (hsame : (r * s').gcd w = (r * s).gcd w) (a h h' : ℤ) :
    let D := (r * s).gcd w
    let d := r.gcd D
    let q := D / d
    let r0 := r / d
    let t := s / q
    let t' := s' / q
    let g := N1.gcd N2
    let d1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart (N1 / g) g
    let n1 := CanonicalReciprocalData.coprimePart (N1 / g) g
    let n2 := N2 / g
    let A := g * d1
    let w0 := w / D
    let b := A * n2 * r0
    let c := n1 * w0
    let zeta := c * p * D * r0
    let K := (p * D) * r0 * w0
    let L := (p * (r * s)).lcm (p * w)

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredOuterCarrier (d : MediumAtom) :
    Finset ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) :=
  let Pairs := (d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
    (d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier ×ˢ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier)).filter
      (fun t => t.2.1 ≠ t.2.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)
  let Tails := (factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ
    ((factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q2)
  Pairs ×ˢ Tails.biUnion (fun t =>
    (t.2.1 * t.2.2).divisors.image (fun D => (t, D)))

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) : Finset (ℕ × ℤ) :=
  factorCarrier d.Q2 ×ˢ
    CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequencyWindow
      (d.sharedSmoothFrequencyBound Z o.2.2)

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) (u : ℕ × ℤ) : ℂ :=
  let p := o.1.1
  let N1 := o.1.2.1
  let N2 := o.1.2.2
  let v := o.2.1.1 * u.1
  let w := o.2.1.2.1 * o.2.1.2.2
  let D := o.2.2
  let q := p * v
  let q' := p * w
  let L := q.lcm q'
  if v.gcd w = D ∧ ComplexCRT.Compatible q q' N1 N2 then
    d.gamma2 u.1 *
      (((CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonSmoothLowPass
          ((d.V / (L : ℝ)) * (u.2 : ℝ) / Z) : ℂ) *
        CommonSmoothCutoff.poissonNonzeroFrequency (d.V / (L : ℝ))
          ((ComplexCRT.residue q q' N1 N2 d.residue : ℝ) / (L : ℝ)) u.2).re : ℂ)
  else 0

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredOuterCoefficient (d : MediumAtom)
    (Ybeta Ysupport : ℝ)
    (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) : ℂ :=
  let N1 := o.1.2.1
  let N2 := o.1.2.2
  if (N1.gcd N2 : ℝ) ≤ Ybeta ∧
      (CanonicalReciprocalData.supportedPart
        (N1 / N1.gcd N2) (N1.gcd N2) : ℝ) ≤ Ysupport then
    d.transposedAtom.beta N1 * star (d.transposedAtom.beta N2) *
      d.gamma3 o.2.1.1 * star (d.gamma3 o.2.1.2.1) * star (d.gamma2 o.2.1.2.2)
  else 0

def MediumAtom.smallCoreSquaredBlock (d : MediumAtom) (Z : ℝ)
    (resonant : Bool) (o : (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ((ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) × ℕ)) : ℂ :=
  ∑ u ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
    ∑ v ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredInnerCarrier Z o,
      if decide (u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ) ∨
          u.2 * (v.1 : ℤ) = -(v.2 * (u.1 : ℤ))) = resonant then
        d.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm Z o u * star (d.smallCoreSquaredRowTerm Z o v)
      else 0

(ho : o ∈ d.smallCoreSquaredOuterCarrier) :
    o.2.1.1 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3 ∧
      o.2.1.2.1 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3 ∧ o.2.1.2.2 ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2 := by
  change o ∈ ((d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier ×ˢ
    (d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier ×ˢ d.transposedAtom.betaCarrier)).filter
      (fun t => t.2.1 ≠ t.2.2 ∧ Nat.ModEq t.1 t.2.1 t.2.2)) ×ˢ
    ((factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ ((factorCarrier d.Q3) ×ˢ factorCarrier d.Q2)).biUnion
      (fun t => (t.2.1 * t.2.2).divisors.image (fun D => (t, D))) at ho
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hImage⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp ho).2
  obtain ⟨D, _hD, he⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hImage
  have het : t = o.2.1 := congrArg Prod.fst he
  rw [← het]
  exact ⟨(Finset.mem_product.mp ht).1,
    (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp ht).2).1,
    (Finset.mem_product.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp ht).2).2⟩

def factorCarrier (Q : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Finset.Icc (Nat.ceil Q) (Nat.floor (2 * Q))

def MediumAdmissible (B : ℕ) (σ κ c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ d.U ∧ 1 ≤ d.V ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q1 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q2 ∧ 1 ≤ d.Q3 ∧
  Real.exp (Real.exp 1) < d.scale ∧
  c0 * d.scale ≤ (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ d.scale ^ (1 + κ) ∧
  d.Q1 < d.U * d.scale ^ (-σ) ∧
  d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * σ) ∧
  (d.residue.natAbs : ℝ) ^ (7 / 32 : ℝ) * d.U * d.Q1 * d.Q2 ^ 5 * d.Q3 ^ 2 <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  d.U ^ (1 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q1 *
      d.Q2 ^ (5 - 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) * d.Q3 ^ (2 + 2 * (7 / 32 : ℝ)) <
    d.scale ^ (2 - 15 * σ) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, ‖d.alpha n‖ ≤ 1) ∧
  (∀ n ∈ d.alphaCarrier, d.alpha n ≠ 0 → ∀ p : ℕ,
    Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n →
      d.scale ^ (1 / (Real.log (Real.log d.scale)) ^ 3) < (p : ℝ)) ∧
  (∀ m ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta m‖ ≤ (m.divisors.card : ℝ) ^ B) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q1, ‖d.gamma1 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma1 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q2, ‖d.gamma2 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma2 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs)) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ factorCarrier d.Q3, ‖d.gamma3 q‖ ≤ 1 ∧
    (d.gamma3 q ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime q d.residue.natAbs))

by the low-rank BV or one-long integer-slot results in this Part. -/

theorem mediumAdmissible_cleanedAlphaAtom
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d.cleanedAlphaAtom := by
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    hAlpha, hRough, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩ := hd
  refine ⟨hU, hV, hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, hx, ha0, ha1, hg1, hg2, hg3, hg4,
    ?_, ?_, hBeta, hGamma1, hGamma2, hGamma3⟩
  · intro n hn
    change ‖d.cleanedAlpha n‖ ≤ 1
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h, norm_zero, zero_le_one]
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hAlpha n hn
  · intro n hn hnz p hp hpn
    apply hRough n hn _ p hp hpn
    change d.cleanedAlpha n ≠ 0 at hnz
    by_cases h : (n : ℤ) ∣ d.residue
    · exact (hnz (by simp only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_pos h])).elim
    · simpa only [MediumAtom.cleanedAlpha, if_neg h] using hnz

The exact products $nm=\mathfrak a$ are removed before Cauchy and
restored in the prescribed order, with separate power bounds.  The
positive principal Gram variance is retained and estimated.  In the
second dispersion term the clean coprimalities give the exact identity
below. Here $e(t)=\exp(2\pi it)$, and a bar denotes the multiplicative
inverse modulo the denominator of the corresponding fraction.
\begin{align}
 &e\left(\frac{\mathfrak a h\overline{n_1w_2}}{qdw_1}
          +\frac{\mathfrak a h\overline{n_2qdw_1}}{w_2}\right)
 \notag\\[-2pt]
 &\quad=
 e\left(\frac{\mathfrak a h(n_1-n_2)
                    \overline{n_2qdw_1}}{n_1w_2}\right)
 e\left(\frac{\mathfrak a h}{qdw_1w_2n_1}\right).
 \label{eq:current-retained-phase}
\end{align}
The last phase is kept.  Partial summation in its five normalized
coordinates costs $x^{5\kappa+o(1)}$, once.  After the coprime
partition and polarization, the spectral return uses a common
completed-variable interval and a common additive phase across levels.
